headline: Contested Sectors See Fresh Base Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, the front has plainly quickened in several divided sectors. Weathered Expanse is the liveliest ground, with 59 strategic-base events in 24 hours, eight in the latest two, and ownership now split five Colonial to four Warden; casualties are accelerating on both sides. Stlican Shelf follows with 41 events, including two in the newest two hours, while its nine bases stand six Warden and three Colonial. Godcrofts has recorded 26 events, two recently, and is divided six Colonial, one Warden, and two neutral. Stonecradle remains a hard-fought five-to-four Warden sector, posting 23 events and three in two hours. Linn Mercy has seen 20 events and two recently, with six Colonial and five Warden bases. Deadlands, formerly active in the last report, has surged to three events in two hours and 13 in 24, while casualties are accelerating sharply; its ledger remains ten Colonial to one Warden. Callahan’s Passage also logged ten events in 24 hours, but none in the latest two and all ten bases remain Warden-held. Elsewhere, most sectors report no recent base movement.
